programs.title: Karobaar : The Business Of Love
programs.desc: Friends Rajiv and Amar go their separate ways after Seema decides to be with Amar rather than Rajiv. Years later, prosecution lawyer Amar is delighted to see Rajiv in court and accused of murder.

programs.title: Munna Baba(dub) (unakaga Ellam Unakka Tamil)
programs.desc: Sakthi, a rich spoilt brat falls for Indhu. His father, Vinu meets his friend Jayaganesh and they agree on a marriage proposal for their children. Sakthi wants to break the deal because he loves Indhu and wants to marry her, but he does not realise that Indhu is Jayaganesh's daughter. He tries to break the engagement by asking his cousins to misbehave and indulge in a fight. Ultimately in the end, the two get married.

programs.title: Omkara
programs.desc: A crime drama based on William Shakespeare's play "Othello". The film follows Omkara, a powerful and feared gangster who trusts his lieutenant , Langda more than anyone. However, Langda plots against Omkara, manipulating him into believing his wife has been unfaithful. The film explores themes of jealousy, betrayal, and revenge, and features powerful performances and intense action sequences.

programs.title: Lucky-No Time For Love
programs.desc: A story of Lucky, a yound girl who is taken in by a wealthy family in Russia after being orphaned in war-torn Afghanistan . While adapting to her new surroundings, she meets a man who is initially distant and unapproachable, but eventually spend more time together and form a deep bond. Despite facing cultural differences and other obstacles, their love perseveres as they strive to be together.
